title: Building permit issuance and portal loads near 345 California Street
count_method: Count rows and distinct permit_number values within each queried radius and date field. A row returned across multiple queries is counted independently for each query.
scope: Snapshot of the current San Francisco DBI extract at retrieval. The loaded-date results include material other than new issuances. Permit locations use assessor block and lot. The data do not establish parcel adjacency.
